independence: Three fresh agent contexts with different request ordering. Requests within a batch share context and can share model-authored helpers. These are not 180 isolated API calls.
isolation: Prompts restricted reads to public schema and assigned batch input. Native tool access was not isolated by a separate filesystem sandbox.
usageNote: Native collaboration tools did not expose per-batch token usage. No usage value is invented.
criterion: Independent positive and isolated negative examples, plus a conservative public-constant and trust-key screen. This does not prove full natural-language equivalence.
